evidence.reason: The fixture's Git helper invokes subprocess.run without an environment override, so an inherited absolute GIT_DIR/GIT_WORK_TREE would redirect `git -C <temp>` to the developer's checkout; subsequent setup `git config` calls can then modify that checkout. The visible setup isolates XDG directories but does not sanitize Git repository-local environment variables, so this is an existing test-isolation defect rather than a new requirement.
